# Commands

Generated from `world/data/verbs.json`, `channels.json`, `socials.json`,
`quests.json` and `world.json`. `node tools/commands.mjs --check` fails if this
file is stale.

## Movement and sight

`north`, `south`, `east`, `west`, `up`, `down` (or `n/s/e/w/u/d`).
`look` shows the room; `look <thing>` and `examine <thing>` show a detail, an
object or a mobile. `who` lists the room; `awake` lists everyone online.
